text_block_list.text:
I... AM... VICTORIOUS! World, behold
the future
Centurial Overlord's power!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Doto's heart is set—not to be my
enemy... but a
mutual motivator. An
eternal rival, it is!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
Rivalry—something which a ruler
requires—will
help me achieve the power
to overthrow the
Golden Generation!
With this settled, the stage is
ready.
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard

text_block_list.text:
The Golden Generation awaits at the
final
battleground... the Arima Kinen!
text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
